professionalSummary.text: Serves as the Product Manager for the mid-market segment of a workflow automation product.
professionalSummary.witness: Product manager for the mid-market segment of a workflow automation product for three years, running discovery with about thirty customers a year and writing the product requirements for the segment's features under the product team's template.

experienceHighlights.text: Runs discovery with mid-market customers and writes the product requirements under the product team's template.
experienceHighlights.witness: Product manager for the mid-market segment of a workflow automation product for three years, running discovery with about thirty customers a year and writing the product requirements for the segment's features under the product team's template.

experienceHighlights.text: Prioritises the backlog with the feature teams under the team's prioritisation method.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prioritised the segment backlog with the two feature teams under the team's weighted prioritisation method, with the scoring sheets and quarterly roadmap reviews filed in the product folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Reports adoption to the product director and records own responsibility boundaries.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reported segment adoption to the product director each quarter, recording in the report which figures were mine and which came from the analytics team.

experienceHighlights.text: Documents roadmap boundaries and hand-over conditions each quarter.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the roadmap boundary note and the hand-over conditions for the segment each quarter.

experienceHighlights.text: Presents the segment roadmap to individual customers in discovery calls and to the sales team at the quarterly sales kick-off.
experienceHighlights.witness: Presented the segment roadmap to individual customers in discovery calls and to the sales team at the quarterly sales kick-off.
